Looking at page 9:
- Top left: continues from page 8, showing the end of §5.4 End-to-End Learning text
- Then "6 Discussion" heading with the compressed single paragraph
- Then "7 Conclusion" 
- Then "Limitations" section with multiple paragraphs
- Right column: continues Limitations + starts References

Wait, it seems like the Discussion and Conclusion are both on page 9, meaning the main body overflows to page 9. But the key question is: does the Conclusion END on page 9 or does it end within page 8?


Looking more carefully, the main body sections (Discussion through Conclusion) are definitely pushed to page 9 due to the dense tables and figures on page 8, which means the layout is more compressed than I initially thought. Looking at page 9 more carefully, I see the end of §5.4 bleeding into the Discussion and Conclusion sections, which means the overflow issue actually stems from earlier content pushing everything down. The Discussion is already stripped to just 5 sentences and the Conclusion to 2, so the real culprit is likely the changes I made to the atlas.tex file — adding "by Gini importance" and the appendix reference, plus expanding the table caption — which probably shifted the float placement and cascaded content downward. Looking at page 8 more carefully, I can see it contains Table 5, Figure 4, Tables 6 and 7, plus sections 5.2 through 5.4 and the start of Discussion. Before the feature importance fix, all of this fit on page 8 with Discussion and Conclusion wrapping up. Now Discussion is spilling onto page 9, which suggests the atlas.tex caption expansion—adding those extra details about RF Gini importance and SHAP coverage—added just enough height to cascade everything down. I should try trimming that caption back to something more concise.
